# Dr. Manjinder Sandhu

> Official website of Dr. Manjinder Sandhu, Senior Interventional Cardiologist and Principal Director of Cardiology. The practice provides consultations in Gurugram, Manesar and New Delhi.

## About

Dr. Manjinder Sandhu has more than 33 years of clinical experience in interventional cardiology. His clinical interests include radial angioplasty and stenting, TAVR/TAVI, pacemaker and ICD implantation, cardiac risk assessment, echocardiography, heart failure management, complex coronary intervention, and endovascular aortic repair.

- [Contact and appointments](https://www.drmanjindersandhu.com/contact-us/): Appointment request form, phone contact and clinic locations.

## Medical information notice

Website content is for general educational purposes and does not replace personal medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Chest pain, breathing difficulty, fainting, or other severe or sudden symptoms need urgent medical assessment.
